title: Fox Finds Itself In a ‘Hell of a Pickle’ as America Turns on Trump
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here. In today's edition, we look at Fox's painful
struggle session during last night's blue tsunami, and how it tells us that
Donald Trump is tied around their necks like an albatross - no matter how much
they'd like to pivot. Plus, did _The Atlantic_ do something about one of its
writers' blatant and gross Islamophobia against **Mehdi** and **Wajahat Ali**?

# **Fox 's Identity Crisis and the Trump Trap**

Throughout[ Tuesday night's stunning wipeout of the Republican
Party](https://zeteo.com/p/republicans-2026-bloodbath-was-way), Fox went
through great pains not to blame the one person obviously responsible for the
blue tsunami - even though everyone on set knew that the results were a
repudiation of Donald Trump.

"Trump is toast, but it's so fucking telling that even while they move on from
him, they won't attack him or throw him under the bus," a former Fox employee
told me late last night.

Indeed, what transpired during the MAGA network's Election Night coverage
amounted to an hours-long struggle session, where the network's stars
desperately looked for any and all excuses for why Democrats completely blew
out the GOP across the country. Just watch:
